channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran says won’t allow US warships to get close as Trump ponders new attacks
item.description: Iranian officials, media and analysts sense war is closer, but signal there will be no backing down.

item.title: Is Iran planning attacks on Americans; why is the US on alert?
item.description: US intelligence memo warns that Iranian plots against US citizens in the Middle East 'have reached advanced stages'.

item.title: Czech Republic advances media funding overhaul despite criticism
item.description: Journalists prepare to strike as politicians push through changes that critics say threaten independence.

item.title: Father who killed Oregon school gunman describes anguish over children he couldn't save
item.description: Kaylub Giamanco has been hailed as a hero for killing a teenager who fatally shot three children and a teacher.

item.title: Israeli forces begin demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers shot dead
item.description: The soldiers were killed in an attack by two Palestinian gunmen at a checkpoint outside the West Bank city on Friday morning.

item.title: Deadly shooting near Paris is a 'racist terrorist attack', Macron says
item.description: One person is killed and five wounded in a series of attacks. The suspected gunman has been apprehended.
